column6: A clerk at the Match Supply Depot is sacked over a misread signature, and chases the official who signed it through a Moscow that will not hold still.
A zoologist finds a ray that makes living things grow at monstrous speed, and a state farm takes it away from him to save the country's chickens.
Two union men on a trip to Leningrad go looking for the wholesome recreation the Labour Code entitles them to, and find an Egyptian mummy.
By the statistics, two people in every thousand are geniuses; a locksmith announces to his wife that his resources are exhausted and that he has had an idea.
The dispatches of a provincial worker-correspondent, printed exactly as sent apart from the spelling: the fireproof American house, and whatever else Blagodatsk has to report.
